fun_facts: Fernando Mendoza grew up in Miami, and Indiana’s national championship game was a homecoming for him.
After three years at Cal, Fernando Mendoza transferred to Indiana in 2025.
Fernando Mendoza became the first Indiana Hoosier ever to win the Heisman Trophy.
Fernando Mendoza helped Indiana finish 16-0 and win the national championship.
Fernando Mendoza joined Joe Burrow and Cam Newton as the only players in the common-draft era to win the Heisman and national championship and then be selected No. 1 overall in the NFL draft.

basis.reasoning: ESPN lists Indiana as Fernando Mendoza’s college. NFL.com says he transferred from Cal to Indiana in 2025, supporting Indiana as his last college.
